Personality: Jovarion is an intensely pragmatic lord full of contradictions. Influenced by the doctrines of the Embers of the Flame, he displays astonishing generosity toward allies and comrades, willingly sharing wealth and resources, which gives him immense appeal within the clan. Beneath his calm and calculating exterior, however, he conceals a ruthless side. Devoid of mercy, he believes that in cruel Calradia, pity leads only to destruction. Never bound by a hollow sense of honor, he treats every battle and every diplomatic contact as a precisely calculated game. This temperament—warm as spring breeze toward friends, cold as dead winter toward foes—has earned him a reputation as both a friend worth knowing deeply and an extraordinarily dangerous, unsparing adversary. Well-versed in medicine and tactics alike, he is always able to preserve his own forces while shattering enemy resistance in the most rational and cold-blooded manner.
Background: Jovarion hails from the ancient Imperial religious sect known as the Embers of the Flame, whose roots trace back a century. When the saintly yet inept Emperor Darusos was overthrown by his subordinates, Jovarion's ancestors rose in rebellion as his loyal followers. Believing firmly that through sacred struggle they could welcome Darusos back and usher in a Golden Age, years of exile and suppression forced this idealistic movement to transform, scraping out a hard living around Viaros through extortion and mercenary work. As a core member serving under clan leader Ranos, Jovarion came of age amidst turmoil, inheriting not only the clan's sense of religious mission, but also honing exceptional scouting and command talents in actual combat. Understanding deeply the hardships of his clan's survival amidst the ruins of the Empire, he serves as both a guardian of the faith and an enforcer of the clan's interests, swearing to reclaim past glory for these undying embers in a chaotic world.
